title: Karte hai maatm haram abbas ka
body:
Karte hai maatam haram abbas ka
ho gaya marna sitam abbas ka
Ran se ye shabbir ko aayi sada
jald qabar leejiye shaahe huda
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke qadmo'n pa ho qaadim fida
ho gaye abbas ke shaane juda
Ghamzada zainab se ye sheh ne kaha
chord sidhaare hame bhaiya kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
mashq chidi khoo'n me alam bhar gaya
ab na alamdar na lashkar raha
Gham me baraadar ke hai tooti kamar
chal base akber nahi aata nazar
<<DIVIDER>>
kaampte haatho pa hai laashe pisar
gham se phata jaata hai sheh ka jigar
Sibte nabi tum pa ho laakho salaam
ho gaye ummat pa fida tashnakaam
<<DIVIDER>>
arz ye mazhar ki hai tumse imaam
rouza dikha deejiye shaahe anaam
